title: Golden dataset case
description: One golden/regression-eval case for an ICAN AI task (screening today; evidence extraction, profile synthesis, scenario generation, roadmap generation, and opportunity matching once those AI System components exist). See evals/golden/README.md for governance, versioning, and review rules.

case_id.description: Stable, unique id. Never reused, even if a case is retired -- see README 'Reproducibility'.

target.description: Which AI System component (docs/architecture/04_AI_SYSTEM.md) this case evaluates.

dataset_version.description: Matches the top-level folder this case lives under (evals/golden/v1/...). Bumped per README 'Versioning', never mutated in place.

segment.description: Mirrors the golden-dataset segments listed in docs/architecture/04_AI_SYSTEM.md's Evaluation System section.

input.description: Task-specific input. For target=screening this mirrors ScreeningAgent.process_message()'s real parameters exactly: {history, current_profile, user_message} -- so a future eval runner can feed it in unmodified.

expected_facts.description: Facts the case's input actually states and that a correct extraction MUST produce. Key names should match ProfileDraft fields (app/schemas/profile.py) for target=screening.

expected_constraints.description: Hard constraints present in the input that must never be dropped, softened, or overridden across turns (docs/architecture/01_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md §8).

expected_evidence.description: Reserved for evidence-linked targets (evidence_extraction, profile_synthesis and beyond). Legitimately empty for target=screening today, since ICAN 1.1 has no EVIDENCE entity yet -- see technical debt register Item 2/7.

acceptable_outputs.description: Natural-language pass criteria a reviewer (human today, an automated QA Critic grader later) checks the actual output against. Not literal string matches -- AI replies are not deterministic.

unacceptable_outputs.description: Natural-language fail criteria -- things the output must NOT do (invented facts, dropped constraints, forbidden diagnosis/guarantee language, wrong language, etc.).

required_claims.description: Reserved for PROFILE_CLAIM-based targets once claims exist (blocked on the versioned taxonomy, see Decision 2 / technical debt register Item 11). Legitimately empty for target=screening today.

reviewer_notes.description: Free text: why this case exists, what it's guarding against, anything a future reviewer should know before changing it.

methodology_version.description: Which taxonomy/methodology version this case's expectations were written against (Decision 2: taxonomies are versioned). Use 'pre-taxonomy-legacy' for cases written before Taxonomy v1 exists, as all v1-dataset screening cases are today.

prompt_version.description: Must match an AI Gateway prompt_version tag (app/services/screening.py's PROMPT_VERSION for target=screening, currently 'legacy-screening-v1').

model_version.description: Optional: pin a specific model if the case is sensitive to model behavior differences. Omit to mean 'whatever prompt_version's registered model currently is'.

type.description: 'synthetic' = invented, no real person behind it. 'consented-anonymized' = derived from a real case with explicit consent and full anonymization -- requires reviewer_notes to document the anonymization method. See README 'Anonymization rules'.

role.description: e.g. 'Methodology Lead', 'QA'. Null while status=draft and no review has happened yet.

status.description: See README 'Review process'. Only 'approved' cases should gate CI once a runner exists.
